card.text: Sun-like star about 554 parsecs away that hosts Kepler-452 b.

introduction.text: Kepler-452 is a Sun-like star about 554 parsecs away, 1.11 times the Sun’s radius. Its planet Kepler-452 b circles it every 385 days.

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of Gaia's spectrum of the star. The darker edge is a model, not a measurement.
